mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals rising economic activity, leading to higher future equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of rising GDPC1, or the relationship weakens in non-expanding economies.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and FEDFUNDS (interest rates) signals a contractionary monetary policy response to inflation, compressing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high INDPRO (supply) and elevated GDPC1 (demand), investor confidence in sustained growth drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of high INDPRO and GDPC1, or the regime is not late-cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high labor demand (PAYEMS) and rising demand (GDPC1) signal robust employment growth and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite high PAYEMS and GDPC1, or the relationship is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals tight labor markets, boosting corporate profits and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 4%, or the effect is transient.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% indicates monetary easing, lowering borrowing costs and stimulating investment, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite FEDFUNDS falling below 3.5%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in RSAFS (demand) coupled with rising UNRATE (labor) signals weakening economic activity and labor market tightness, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate a potential recession recovery.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not rise significantly (p > 0.05) despite RSAFS declining and UNRATE rising, or the interaction effect is not robust.
